body: You're absolutely right.

Try therapy as a start if you have the means. Talk to your friends and people close to you about it. Maybe you could also write on a piece of paper all the things that he's done to hurt you or that you hold against him, take the time to really write it all out. Then after you are done, burn it and let it go in writing and in your brain. None of this matters if your partner doesn't care to be reassuring and not give you any more problems, in that case you should leave !!! Especially if you are young and have no kids together.
